name: Rapoo M50 Plus Silent
notes: 186-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Rapoo M50 Plus Silent, from the udev-hid-bpf project's copy of the device's descriptor: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libevdev/udev-hid-bpf/-/blob/bbaad639d4b2efe2a909e8b7c594b91e87704ab8/src/bpf/stable/0010-Rapoo__M50-Plus-Silent.bpf.c#L26-117. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
